verdict.rationale: Inngest is fundamentally an event-driven automation engine: functions trigger automatically on events, cron schedules, or step.waitForEvent(), with durable execution, retries, and flow control built in, and this extends explicitly to AI/agent workflows (durable agents, agent tool loops, step.ai). This directly matches 'define rules that trigger actions automatically on events.' Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating event-trigger rule authoring UX (community quotes focus on general reliability/DX, not rule-definition specifics), and no evidence of a declarative rule-builder UI beyond code-based triggers.
